prompts.label: First Celery app with Redis broker
prompts.text:
Create minimal Celery app with Redis broker.

- pip install celery redis
- app = Celery('tasks', broker='redis://localhost:6379/0')
- @app.task def add(x, y)
- celery -A tasks worker --loglevel=info and call add.delay(2,3)

Show tasks.py and terminal commands.

prompts.label: Production deployment checklist
prompts.text:
